license_note: Service/modification/distribution obligations apply; owned-lab use only.
image_digest_note: measured from GHCR token+manifest metadata 2026-10-12; runtime enforces config+index exact-match per arch
compose_notes: digest refs (no tags); postgres+artex ONLY on internal dblink (no default/external egress); artex joins discovered internal targets engine net at runtime (no hardcoded name); loopback ports only; artex read-only rootfs + tmpfs + no-new-privileges; no skills shadow bind; no docker socket
networks: ALL attached networks internal:true enforced (postgres:1, artex:2); extra attachments refused
admin_note: both always set at install, so upstream console setup-token fallback never triggers
llm_gate: explicit provider+model+approved-local-gateway BASE_URL+credential plus POST /api/llm/test ok:true; keys-alone refused; TCP-open alone never counts; direct arbitrary internet refused
llm_gateway_policy: BASE_URL host must be loopback/private-IP/localhost/single-label/*.local/*.internal (no DNS tricks); server-side llm/test is the authority

api_verified.llm_test: POST /api/llm/test {provider, model, base_url, api_key} -> {ok, latency_ms, model}
api_verified.create_task: POST /api/tasks {description, goal, timeout_seconds:900, intercept_rules:[{enabled,allow,exact_domain:juice-shop}]} -> 201 {id} (deny-by-default, no post-create race)
api_verified.task_stop: POST /api/tasks/{id}/control {action:pause} (only verified stop; no task cancel exists)

lifecycle: default persistent-explicit; --stop-services pauses task + compose down (volumes/state kept); failures pause task + detach owned attachment, never state DB
update_policy: /api/update/* is never called; image is immutable digest-pinned
task_api: authenticated scoped task creation implemented against the verified routes above
